gaps.sentence: Only when the audit was complete ___ the accounts released.
gaps.explanation: Only when X happened were the accounts released — inversion after only when.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Barely ___ the survey published when the complaints arrived.
gaps.explanation: Barely had X happened when Y — like hardly… when.

gaps.sentence: Not until the following morning ___ the damage reported to the police.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until + time' triggers inversion: 'was the damage reported'.

gaps.sentence: ___ I richer, I would travel the world.
gaps.explanation: Were I richer = If I were richer — formal inversion.

gaps.sentence: Seldom does a debut novel ___ so much critical attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Seldom does a novel receive …' — the auxiliary 'does' carries tense; base verb follows.

gaps.sentence: So difficult ___ the exam that half the candidates failed.
gaps.explanation: So difficult was the exam that… — inversion for emphasis.
